text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is Christmas.
Many of the Umamusume are bustling about
in high spirits, preparing for parties.
choice_data_list: (I wonder if Mr. C.B. will be participating too)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a stroll around the academy for a change of pace from work,
but Mr. C.B. was nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer.
What a coincidence running into you here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hm, just as it looks.
I was taking a walk, heard some kids' voices,
and my feet just kind of carried me here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
They told me Santa is coming today.
Everyone's so excited, it's really adorable.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"You're having a party at home now...?
Oh, come to think of it,
weren't we having a party at the academy too?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I'm not really in the mood for that right now.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I love the festive Christmas atmosphere
and the decorations you don't usually see, so
I was just taking a stroll.”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm satisfied now.
I'm already kind of sick of Christmas songs anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The park is quiet and nice, but it's a bit chilly...
Maybe I should head into a family restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it's Christmas—"
is not something I think.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Always doing things her own way.
Seeing her act so true to herself brings a sense of relief.
choice_data_list: So, will you go out with me?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind, but...
I'm not doing anything special, you know?
I really was just wandering around."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go.
I feel like having something warm to drink.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There aren't many people around.
I guess not a lot of folks come to a family restaurant on Christmas?
choice_data_list: It might be even more crowded at night.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I see. Looks like there'll be more families visiting. 
When I was a kid, my parents used to cook
all kinds of food for me, but...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it's just the two of them, Mom and Dad.
Maybe they're throwing love hearts all over the place, just like back when they were dating.
choice_data_list: You two really get along well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, indeed.
Sometimes to the point where it's too painful to watch.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And Mom always tells me:
'When you find someone special, be sure to let me know, okay?'

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of person becomes "special." Even if I found someone like that, I don't feel like I could ever be like them.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Saying 'I love you', gazing affectionately with a smile...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I can't even imagine.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, they've got quite a variety.
Rudolf's here too...
Ah, they have mine as well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I remember Dad and the others
saying they bought one too."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Do you, like, have any?
My merch, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, are you really that surprised?
Now I'm curious.
Do you have it? Or not?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I passed by this shop before,
I spotted some Mr. C.B. merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, out of embarrassment...
I couldn't bring myself to buy it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After much hesitation, I decided not to buy it.
Averting my eyes, I answer softly.
...It feels a bit awkward.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: If you were gonna agonize over it so much, you should've just bought it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The truth was that I felt embarrassed—
but saying even that was far too humiliating.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I see.
...Yeah. Then follow me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Following after Mr. C.B., we arrived at—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's still bright out, but...
This place feels so much like Christmas, I think it's pretty nice.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Come on, over here.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Trainer, lend me your smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without really understanding what was going on, I handed over my smartphone.
Mr. C.B. lined up right next to me,
pointed the phone back toward us, and—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"This is what you'd call 'limited-edition merch'...
right? Even if it's just a photo."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the returned smartphone screen,
there was a smiling Mr. C.B.
and a panicked, bewildered version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll pass.
I'm just not in the mood for it anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. Ahahaha.
Just give it up, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You know very well
that Mr. C.B. is this kind of Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I knew that. Yet, I felt like she showed me a smile that was somehow different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: If you were gonna agonize over it so much, you should've just bought it.
choice_data_list: Well, the real deal is always right beside me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to admit that I was embarrassed, I gave an evasive answer. Mr. C.B. blinked in surprise for a moment, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, right, it's Christmas.
I'll be right back."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was left dumbfounded,
Mr. C.B. briskly walked off
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A short while later,
she came back as if nothing had happened.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Without understanding the meaning behind the words "It was Christmas, right?", they changed locations and kept wandering around, until...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whew, we've walked a ton.
I'm totally fine, but what about
you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
Still the same as ever, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, remember what I said before?
About how 'I feel like something is missing inside me.'"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Whenever I'm with you, Trainer,
sometimes I just go, "Huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A strange sensation, as if the gaps are being filled in.
It's truly just for a moment, a fleeting flash, but still.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Before I can even think about whether it's good or bad, it just fades away, so I don't really have a proper answer for you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. So in the end,
I just have to do what I want and act however I feel like, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: And so—here, this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I bought it at that shop earlier.
Buying my own merch felt a little embarrassing, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Inside was a keychain featuring a small Mr. C.B. plushie."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "...You said 'the real thing is always right next to me,' didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I probably won't be around ‘all the time.’
So bear with that when I'm not here."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I feel like you'd manage to find me
no matter where I hid anyway...
Just a hunch."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...It's fine, really.
I just happened to feel like it, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Mr. C.B.
turned her back to leave.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How should I repay her—I pondered as I watched
her slightly fidgety back.
